Join the live broadcast of this AFC Champions League Elite clash, as Seoul host Melbourne City in a crucial East Zone matchup. Hosts sit 4th with 8 points, visitors top the group with 9 points after 5 rounds.

Seoul vs Melbourne City: Match Preview

Seoul

2 wins, 2 draws, 1 loss in ACL Elite, averaging 1.4 goals per game. Jesse Lingard netted twice last outing, playing his final match for the club.

Persib Bandung vs Bangkok United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch the live broadcast of this AFC Champions League Two Group G clash as Indonesia's Persib Bandung host Thailand's Bangkok United in a crucial matchday 6 encounter. Both teams top the group with 10 points from 5 games (3W-1D-1L), and the winner will gain a significant advantage in the playoff race.

Kick-off: December 10, 2025, 15:15 MSK (12:15 UTC)
Stadium: Gelora Bandung Lautan Api, Bandung, Indonesia (capacity 38,000)
Competition: AFC Champions League Two, Group G

Persib Bandung vs Bangkok United: Match Preview

Persib secured a crucial 2-0 away win over Bangkok in their first meeting in October 2025, giving the hosts a psychological edge heading into this reverse fixture. The Thai side remain unbeaten in their last 6 matches and are eager for revenge on the road.

Team Form and Analysis

Persib Bandung

The Indonesian side deliver consistent results backed by passionate home support at their FIFA-standard stadium. Key players Marc Klok, Berguinho, and Frans Putros have returned to strengthen the squad. Striker A Jung has netted 4 goals in 5 tournament matches, leading the team's scoring charts.

Bangkok United

The Thai outfit dominate possession averaging 58-62% and create pressure through ball retention and corners (averaging 8 per game). Forward Al-Ghassani has scored 3 tournament goals, though the team suffered a 0-2 defeat to Persib away.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persib Bandung (4-3-3): Wikri - Putra, Da Silva, Rosyid, Ruminta - Klok, Ersan, Gabriel - Rahman, A Jung, Berguinho.
  • Bangkok United (4-2-3-1): Warrawat - Michael, Wutthikorn, Sarawut, Ramon - Bistrovic, Devic - Porawut, Wander, Beck - Al-Ghassani.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This top-of-the-table clash promises tight competition, with Persib's home advantage potentially proving decisive.

  • Main Prediction: Persib Bandung to Win (1) or Double Chance 1X. Hosts already beat Bangkok 2-0 and benefit from home crowd support.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. First meeting ended 2-0, both sides defensively disciplined. Likely scoreline: 1-0 or 2-1.

Selangor vs Lion City Sailors: Match Preview

Selangor come into this game on a five-match losing streak in the group, struggling defensively and facing elimination without victory. Lion City Sailors maintain a positive 9:8 goal difference and remain among the group’s top sides, needing points to stay in contention.

Selangor

The Malaysian side concede around two goals per game and often collapse late in matches when chasing the result. They lost the first head-to-head 4-2 but showed attacking potential with two goals away from home.

Lion City Sailors

The Singaporean club sit near the top thanks to strong attacking numbers, averaging about 2.4 goals scored and 1 conceded per match. Forward Chrigor has scored 4 goals in 5 ACL Two appearances and is the main danger man up front.

  • Lion City Sailors (4-3-3): Susak - Nazar, Lopes, Hami, Nur - Sonjo, Hanees, Shahir - Chrigor, Henrique, Kim.

Villarreal vs Copenhagen: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch the live broadcast of this UEFA Champions League clash as Spanish side Villarreal host Danish Copenhagen in a crucial matchday 6 encounter. Hosts sit 34th with 1 point (0W-1D-4L, 2:10), visitors 29th with 4 points (1W-1D-3L, 7:14).

Kick-off: December 10, 2025, 20:45 MSK (17:45 UTC)
Stadium: Estadio de la Cerámica, Villarreal (capacity 21,332)
Competition: UEFA Champions League, League Phase

Villarreal vs Copenhagen: Match Preview

Villarreal have struggled in Europe with only 1 point, failing to score in four of five matches, though they remain solid at home in La Liga. Copenhagen secured their first Champions League win last time out and hold a 3-point advantage, but miss suspended midfielder Lerager.

Team Form and Analysis

Villarreal

The Yellow Submarine scored 31 goals from xG 28.89 (+2.11) and conceded just 13 from xGA 18.20 (-5.2) across 15 season matches, showing defensive quality. They dominate at home in La Liga but face psychological pressure in the Champions League with only one point.

Copenhagen

The Danes concede an average 2.8 goals per game in the competition, exposing serious defensive vulnerabilities. They recently lost 0-2 domestically and travel without their key midfielder, weakening the center.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Villarreal (4-4-2): Jørgensen - Cardona, Veiga, Foyth, Navarro - Gueye, Comesaña, Parejo, Mojica - Ayoze, Barry.
  • Copenhagen (4-1-4-1): Traubin - Diks, Sorensen, Pancev, Kullberg - Achuna - Claesson, Falk, Otto, Osame - Larsson.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Hosts are clear favorites at odds 1.42-1.53, with bookmakers giving them a 65.2% win probability.

  • Main Prediction: Villarreal to Win with (-1) Handicap. The Spanish side must capitalize on home advantage and visitors' defensive frailties for a comfortable victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Despite Copenhagen's defensive issues, Villarreal have struggled to score in UCL. Likely scoreline: 2-0 or 1-1.

Stadium: Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium, Baku (capacity 31,200)

Qarabag vs Ajax: Match Preview

Qarabag become favorites in a Champions League home match for the first time ever, fighting for playoff qualification with a one-point cushion over nearest rivals. Ajax endure a catastrophic European season without any points and a -15 goal difference, the worst record among all participants.

Team Form and Analysis

Qarabag

The Azerbaijani side started with victories over Benfica (3-2) and Copenhagen (2-0), then suffered losses to Athletic Bilbao (1-3) and Napoli (0-2), plus drew with Chelsea (2-2). At home they average 2.4 goals per Champions League match, creating xG 1.5+ in 14 of their last 14 games.

Ajax

The Amsterdam club lost all five matches: to Inter (0-2), Marseille (0-4), Chelsea, Galatasaray, and Benfica, conceding 16 goals while scoring just once. Despite domestic success in Eredivisie, Ajax failed to earn any points away in Europe.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Qarabag (4-5-1): Kochalski - Mustafazade, Medina, Silva, Jafarquliyev - Jankovic, Zoubir, Andrade, Pizzelli, Addai - Duran.
  • Ajax (4-3-3): Pasveer - Rosa, Itakura, Baas, Wijndal - Reger, Klaassen, Hluh - Bounida, Godts, Dolberg.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Hosts are favorites at odds 1.95-2.20 with a 49.3-51.3% win probability according to bookmakers.

  • Main Prediction: Qarabag to Win (1) or Double Chance 1X. Azerbaijanis remain unbeaten at home in the tournament, while Ajax sit without points and with the worst defense in their UCL history.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. 10 of Qarabag's 13 UCL/UEL league phase games exceeded this mark. Likely scoreline: 3-0 or 2-1.

Real Madrid vs Manchester City: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch the headline fixture of UEFA Champions League matchday 6 as Spain's Real Madrid host England's Manchester City at the Santiago Bernabéu. Hosts sit 5th with 12 points (4W-0D-1L, 12:5), visitors 9th with 10 points (3W-1D-1L, 10:5).

Kick-off: December 10, 2025, 23:00 MSK (20:00 UTC)
Stadium: Santiago Bernabéu, Madrid (capacity 81,044)
Competition: UEFA Champions League, League Phase

Real Madrid vs Manchester City: Match Preview

The teams meet for the fifth consecutive season in the Champions League, renewing one of European football's most thrilling rivalries. City arrive on a three-match Premier League winning streak and remain unbeaten away in the UCL (victories over Villarreal 0-2, draw with Monaco 2-2), while also winning at home against Napoli and Borussia Dortmund.

Team Form and Analysis

Real Madrid

The Royal Club boast an excellent record against English sides at home and chase their fifth tournament win at the Bernabéu this season. The attack features Kylian Mbappé, Vinícius Júnior, and Jude Bellingham, forming one of Europe's most dangerous trios. Injuries: Carvajal, Militão, Alexander-Arnold, Mendy, Camavinga.

Manchester City

The Citizens led by Erling Haaland (20 season goals, 5 in UCL) sit second in the Premier League after three straight domestic wins. The team won at the Bernabéu only once five years ago, making this task particularly challenging.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Real Madrid (4-3-3): Courtois - Valverde, Rüdiger, Asencio, García - Ceballos, Tchouaméni, Bellingham - Rodrygo, Mbappé, Vinícius.
  • Manchester City (4-2-3-1): Ederson - Khusanov, Stones, Dias, Gvardiol - Gündogan, Gonzalez - Foden, Silva, Savinho - Haaland.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Real Madrid are favorites with a 51.72% win probability at odds around 2.7, while City have a 37.4% chance at 2.55.

  • Main Prediction: Real Madrid to Win (1) or Double Chance 1X. Home advantage at the Bernabéu and the brilliant attacking trio should deliver success for the hosts.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both clubs possess powerful attacks, and their head-to-head history is packed with goals. Likely scoreline: 3-2 or 2-1.
